description: An unmarked parcel, taped a little too carefully, no docket and no return address. Someone went out of their way to make it look like nothing. You weren't told what's inside and you didn't ask. If the wrong person asks to see it, it's gone.
name: an unmarked parcel

tags.description: An unmarked parcel, taped a little too carefully, no docket. Don't ask what's inside.
